title: Duality, Reconstruction, and Structural Toolkit Theorems in Algebraic Phase Theory
summary: We study finite-depth reconstruction frameworks based on representation theory and show that non-rigid reconstruction behaviour is naturally accompanied by intrinsic structural boundaries. Within the finite-depth setting considered in this paper, reconstruction is controlled up to boundary equivalence by the associated filtered representation data together with boundary stratification.
